form.label: MCP Service Demo
form.description: Telemetry published by the deterministic checkout degradation scenario.

search.query: `mcp_demo_base` earliest=-7d | stats max(_time) as latest by demo_run_id | sort 0 - latest | head 1 | fields demo_run_id

`mcp_demo_base` demo_run_id="$run_id$" service=checkout-api event_type=request | stats count as requests count(eval(tonumber(status_code)>=500)) as errors | eval error_rate=round(errors*100/requests,1)."%"
`mcp_demo_base` demo_run_id="$run_id$" service=checkout-api event_type=request | stats perc95(duration_ms) as p95_ms | eval p95_ms=round(p95_ms)." ms"
`mcp_demo_base` demo_run_id="$run_id$" service=checkout-api event_type=request status_code>=500 | stats count
`mcp_demo_base` demo_run_id="$run_id$" service=checkout-api event_type=request | timechart span=5m count as requests count(eval(tonumber(status_code)>=500)) as errors perc95(duration_ms) as p95_ms
`mcp_demo_base` demo_run_id="$run_id$" level=ERROR | sort 0 - _time | table _time service message status_code duration_ms host trace_id version
`mcp_demo_base` demo_run_id="$run_id$" event_type=deployment | sort 0 - _time | table _time service message version host
